pairs.target: liǎngmíng xīn jià gōng xiān chī wán zǎofàn , cái gēn tāmen shàngshān .
pairs.english: The two new riggers finished breakfast before joining them uphill.
pairs.hanzi: 两名新架工先吃完早饭，才跟他们上山。

pairs.target: níng qí yuánběn yǐjīng bèi qǐ xiāngzǐ , kànjiàn qízhōng yì rén yòu qù shèng zhōu , zuǐ zhāng le zhāng , méi cuī .
pairs.english: Ningqi already had her case on her back. Seeing one fetch more porridge, she opened her mouth but did not hurry him.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐原本已经背起箱子，看见其中一人又去盛粥，嘴张了张，没催。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiāng zìjǐ de tú tǒng fàng huí zhuōbiān , yě zuòxià tiān le bànwǎn . tǎ wéi gēnzhe zuò , míngmíng chī guò , wén zhe guō lǐ nà diǎn jiāngwèi , jìng yòu juéde è .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng put his tube back and sat for half a bowl more. Tavi joined him; despite having eaten, the ginger smell from the pot made him hungry again.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡将自己的图筒放回桌边，也坐下添了半碗。塔维跟着坐，明明吃过，闻着锅里那点姜味，竟又觉得饿。

pairs.target: zhèhuí yào qù hòu xíng wū wàicè de jiǎnxiū tái .
pairs.english: This time they were going to the maintenance platform outside the waiting house.
pairs.hanzi: 这回要去候行屋外侧的检修台。

pairs.target: shǒu lù rén tóng níng qí hé guò , xiān yóu jià gōng jiǎnchá jiù tī hé tàbǎn , jià hǎo dúlì de mù tái , pángrén cáinéng dào xīn lán shéng yǐnèi .
pairs.english: The keeper had confirmed with Ningqi: riggers must first check the old steps and boards and erect an independent wooden platform before others entered the new cordon.
pairs.hanzi: 守路人同宁岐核过，先由架工检查旧梯和踏板，架好独立的木台，旁人才能到新拦绳以内。

pairs.target: fēng zhe de cháng kuà réng bùxǔ zǒu , bùnéng yīnwèi duō lái le liǎnggè rén , jiù jiāng yílù hóng mùpái dàngzuò zhuāngshì .
pairs.english: The sealed long span remained off limits; two more people did not turn all the red signs into decorations.
pairs.hanzi: 封着的长跨仍不许走，不能因为多来了两个人，就将一路红木牌当作装饰。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méi bèi pài qù bèi cháng xiāng . tā fùzé bǎ yuánlái cè guò de diǎn yíchùchù duì gěi xīn lái de rén kàn , yù hé ná zhe jìlù gēn zài pángbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi was not assigned the long case. He showed the newcomers the earlier measuring points one by one, with Yuhe beside him carrying the records.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没被派去背长箱。他负责把原来测过的点一处处对给新来的人看，郁禾拿着记录跟在旁边。

pairs.target: shàngcì zǒng zài qiántou de ā xún jīnrì tídēng zǒu hòutou , jiàn tā zhuǎnwān shí chādiǎn yòng tú tǒng zhuàngqiáng , shēnshǒu jiēguò qù , liězuǐ xiào , shuō zǒngsuàn lún dào tā yě cháng chū bàngè rén .
pairs.english: Axun, usually ahead, carried the lamp behind today. As Tavi nearly hit the wall with his tube at a turn, he took it and grinned: now Tavi had grown half an extra person too.
pairs.hanzi: 上次总在前头的阿荀今日提灯走后头，见他转弯时差点用图筒撞墙，伸手接过去，咧嘴笑，说总算轮到他也长出半个人。

pairs.target: jiǎnxiū tái bǐ hòu xíng wū ǎi yìcéng , tóudǐng yā zhe jiù shízuò shēnchū de yíduàn , méi cóng xià tóu kànqǐlái nàme chǎngliàng .
pairs.english: The maintenance platform was one level below the waiting house, overhung by the old stone base, less open than it looked from below.
pairs.hanzi: 检修台比候行屋矮一层，头顶压着旧石座伸出的一段，没从下头看起来那么敞亮。

pairs.target: liǎngmíng jià gōng bǎ jiù tàbǎn fānguòlái , lǐmiàn yìjiǎo yǐjīng sōng liè , miànshàng què zhī kànjiàn jǐdào qiǎn wén .
pairs.english: The riggers turned an old board over: a corner was cracked loose underneath, though only shallow lines showed on top.
pairs.hanzi: 两名架工把旧踏板翻过来，里面一角已经松裂，面上却只看见几道浅纹。

pairs.target: niánzhǎng de nàge ná zhǐjié qiāoqiāo , shuō zhèkuài bùnéng liú , jiào ā xún dì xīn bǎn .
pairs.english: The older one tapped with his knuckles, said it could not stay, and asked Axun for a new board.
pairs.hanzi: 年长的那个拿指节敲敲，说这块不能留，叫阿荀递新板。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bāng zhe zài wūlǐ liáng cái , búdào wàitou còu . xīn bǎn qǐxiān cháng le yì zhǐ , jùmò luò zài tā xiémiàn , ā xún xián zìjǐ huà de xiàn wāi le , xiǎng zài xiū dé qí xiē ,
pairs.english: Tavi helped measure and cut inside. At first the board was a finger too long, sawdust falling on his shoes. Axun wanted to neaten his crooked line,
pairs.hanzi: 塔维帮着在屋里量裁，不到外头凑。新板起先长了一指，锯末落在他鞋面，阿荀嫌自己画的线歪了，想再修得齐些，

pairs.target: niánzhǎng jià gōng jiào tā xiān shì , bié wèile hǎokàn yòu xiāoduǎn . liǎnggè rén táichūqù , gānghǎo kǎzhù ; ā xún huítóu duì tǎ wéi zhǎ yíxiàyǎn , xiàngshì bǎ nà jù méi shuō chūkǒu de déyì fēngěi le tā .
pairs.english: But the older rigger told him to try first rather than trim it short for appearances. They carried it out: a perfect fit. Axun winked at Tavi, sharing his unspoken pride.
pairs.hanzi: 年长架工叫他先试，别为了好看又削短。两个人抬出去，刚好卡住；阿荀回头对塔维眨一下眼，像是把那句没说出口的得意分给了他。

pairs.target: děng mù táijià wěn , yù hé cái dài tā xiàqù . tā yìzhī shǒuwòzhe xīn fú gān , lìngyìzhī bào zhǐ , dìyīcì zhēn cóng nà piànshí zuò dǐxià kànjiàn le kōng chù .
pairs.english: Once the platform was secure, Yuhe took him down. Holding the new rail in one hand and paper in the other, he truly saw the emptiness beneath the stone base for the first time.
pairs.hanzi: 等木台架稳，郁禾才带他下去。他一只手握着新扶杆，另一只抱纸，第一次真从那片石座底下看见了空处。

pairs.target: fēng wǎng yīlǐng lǐ zuàn , dài zhe héshuǐ hé shài cǎo de wèi . yù hé liángwán jìnchù , jiāng tā de zhǐjiá hǎo , dì lái yìzhī duǎn wàng jìng .
pairs.english: Wind entered his collar, smelling of river and drying grass. After measuring nearby, Yuhe clipped his papers and handed him a short telescope.
pairs.hanzi: 风往衣领里钻，带着河水和晒草的味。郁禾量完近处，将他的纸夹好，递来一只短望镜。

pairs.target: yuǎn pō búshì yì zhěngmiàn huī , yǒu jǐkuài ànhóng tiē zài lǜ lǐ , fàngxià wàng jìng cái fāxiàn nà shì wūdǐng , búshì shítou .
pairs.english: The far slope was not wholly gray. Dark red patches lay in green, and lowering the telescope he realized they were roofs, not stones.
pairs.hanzi: 远坡不是一整面灰，有几块暗红贴在绿里，放下望镜才发现那是屋顶，不是石头。

pairs.target: tā hěn xiǎng duō kàn yíhuìer , yù hé yǐ zài jiào diǎn hào . tǎ wéi hái huíwàng jìng , yìng le , dūnxià duì kè zhe jiù hào de xiǎo miànbǎn ,
pairs.english: He wanted to look longer, but Yuhe was calling point numbers. Tavi returned the telescope, answered, and crouched to match a small panel incised with an old number,
pairs.hanzi: 他很想多看一会儿，郁禾已在叫点号。塔维还回望镜，应了，蹲下对刻着旧号的小面板，

pairs.target: pángbiān pái zhe jǐgè āo jìnqù de kòngwèi , qízhōng liǎnggè hái liú zhe duàndiào de duǎněr . tāmen tóng zuótiān tú shàng de fānggé wèizhì jiējìn , chǐcùn què bìng bù yíyàng .
pairs.english: Beside it lay recessed spaces, two retaining broken short lugs. Their positions resembled yesterday's squares, but their sizes differed.
pairs.hanzi: 旁边排着几个凹进去的空位，其中两个还留着断掉的短耳。它们同昨天图上的方格位置接近，尺寸却并不一样。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐ zhuǎnzhèng , xiān zhǎochū néng duì shàng de jiǎo , bù bǎ měigè kòngwèi dōu yìng sāijìn yì gé .
pairs.english: He aligned the paper, first finding corners that matched rather than forcing every recess into a square.
pairs.hanzi: 他将纸转正，先找出能对上的角，不把每个空位都硬塞进一格。

pairs.target: níng qí cóng lìngyìbiān liángguòlái , wèn tā wèishénme liú le yíchù bái . tā zhǐ gěi tā kàn , shuō zhèlǐ bǐ tú shàng duō yídào biān , ruò zhào nàge hào xiě , hòumiàn quán yào yí .
pairs.english: Ningqi measured from the other side and asked about one blank. He showed her an extra edge compared with the drawing: using that number would shift everything after it.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐从另一边量过来，问他为什么留了一处白。他指给她看，说这里比图上多一道边，若照那个号写，后面全要移。

pairs.target: tā kàn le piànkè , jiào yù hé guòlái , sān rén bǎ yuánlái de chāo tú yìtóng tānkāi .
pairs.english: After looking a moment, she called Yuhe over and the three spread out the original copy together.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了片刻，叫郁禾过来，三人把原来的抄图一同摊开。

pairs.target: yuánlái nà piàn zhézhǐ shàng háiyǒu yìtiáo dàn xiàn , miáo shí yǐwéi shì zhǐ zhéhén , méichāo jìnqù .
pairs.english: A faint line on the folded sheet had been mistaken for a crease and omitted from the copy.
pairs.hanzi: 原来那片折纸上还有一条淡线，描时以为是纸折痕，没抄进去。

pairs.target: níng qí méi ràng tā huíqù zhòng zhǎo lǎofù , jiāng zhǐbiān tóng shíwù bǐ hǎo , zài lìng yìzhāng zhǐ shàng bǔ chū kěnéng de wèizhì , biāo le dài hé , bù ná jīnrì suǒ jiàn tì yuántú tiānchéng zhēnde .
pairs.english: Ningqi did not send him back to the keeper, but compared paper and object, marking a possible position on a separate sheet as unverified, not adding today's observation to the original as fact.
pairs.hanzi: 宁岐没让他回去重找老妇，将纸边同实物比好，在另一张纸上补出可能的位置，标了待核，不拿今日所见替原图添成真的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒudiǎn àonǎo , yù hé quèshuō zìjǐ dāngshí yě ànzhe nà dào zhé , ruò yào āimà , défēn tā bànfèn .
pairs.english: Tavi felt frustrated, but Yuhe said she had held that fold down too; if blame was coming, she deserved half.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点懊恼，郁禾却说自己当时也按着那道折，若要挨骂，得分她半份。

pairs.target: líkāi qián , tǎ wéi yòu jièlái wàng jìng , kàn le kàn nà jǐkuài ànhóng .
pairs.english: Before leaving, Tavi borrowed the telescope again to look at the dark red roofs.
pairs.hanzi: 离开前，塔维又借来望镜，看了看那几块暗红。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng wèn kànjiàn shénme , tā shuō nàbiān yě yǒurén zhù , wèn yǐhòu huì buhuì qù .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng asked what he saw. He said people lived over there too and asked whether they would go someday.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡问看见什么，他说那边也有人住，问以后会不会去。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng jiēguò wàng jìng , kàn wán shuō xiàn yòng de lù dé wǎng nán rào , láihuí bùzhǐ bànrì , dé kàn hòutou nǎ yíchù zhēn yào tāmen qù zuòhuó .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng looked through it and said the current road detoured south, more than half a day's return journey; it depended on where the next job actually needed them.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡接过望镜，看完说现用的路得往南绕，来回不止半日，得看后头哪一处真要他们去做活。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , xīnlǐ què méi gēnzhe diǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, though not inwardly.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，心里却没跟着点。

pairs.target: tā bùxiǎng měicì wàngjiàn yìdiǎn yuǎnchù , jiù zhī duōjì yìtiáo ràoxíng de lù , děng yǒurén jiāng zìjǐ de míngzì tián jìn gōng dān .
pairs.english: He did not want every glimpse of distance to mean only another detour noted, waiting for someone to put his name on a work order.
pairs.hanzi: 他不想每次望见一点远处，就只多记一条绕行的路，等有人将自己的名字填进工单。

pairs.target: zhège niàntou láide yǒuxiē bùjiǎnglǐ , tā yě zhīdào jīnrì háiyǒu biérén de huó , biàn méi jiēzhe wèn , bǎ diǎn hào yòu niàn le yìhuí .
pairs.english: The thought felt unreasonable, and he knew others had work today too, so he stopped asking and read the point number again.
pairs.hanzi: 这个念头来得有些不讲理，他也知道今日还有别人的活，便没接着问，把点号又念了一回。

pairs.target: xiàshān shí , xīn jià gōng zài hòumiàn jiǎng shuíjiā de xiǎohái zuì huì páshù , ā xún shuō zìjǐ xiǎoshíhòu jiù cóng zhèlǐ pá guò , bèi wènqǐ dàodǐ duō xiǎo , lìjí bìzuǐ .
pairs.english: Descending, the new riggers talked behind them about whose children climbed trees best. Axun said he had climbed here as a child, then fell silent when asked exactly how small.
pairs.hanzi: 下山时，新架工在后面讲谁家的小孩最会爬树，阿荀说自己小时候就从这里爬过，被问起到底多小，立即闭嘴。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào qǐlái , hūrán xiǎng děng huí bái jiē , xiān ná yíduàn zìjǐ de lù lái wèn nài lěi , bù zhī wèn tā biérén cóng nǎlǐ huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and suddenly wanted, back at White Steps, to ask Nerai about a route of his own, not only where others had returned from.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑起来，忽然想等回白阶，先拿一段自己的路来问奈蕾，不只问她别人从哪里回来。

pairs.target: dào kèzhàn , níng qí yǐ zài zhuōshàng tānkāi jīnrì de shù , quē de yìbiān zǒngsuàn yǒu le , bàogào què hái méi xiěchéng zhǔn xíng .
pairs.english: At the inn Ningqi had spread today's figures on the table. The missing side was finally measured, but the report still granted no passage.
pairs.hanzi: 到客栈，宁岐已在桌上摊开今日的数，缺的一边总算有了，报告却还没写成准行。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng xiémiàn jùmò dǎn diào , shēnshǒu mō chū nà zhāng biāo le " dài hé " de zhǐ , méiyǒu sāi huí biérén de túlǐ , zìjǐ lìng fàngzài le zuì shàngtóu .
pairs.english: Tavi brushed sawdust off his shoes and took out the sheet marked “unverified.” Rather than tuck it into someone else's drawing, he put it on top separately.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将鞋面锯末掸掉，伸手摸出那张标了“待核”的纸，没有塞回别人的图里，自己另放在了最上头。
